usedFor: Keap Max Classic holds contacts, and Google Docs records each “New Contact Created” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Keap Max Classic, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: New contacts are written into a doc tab, giving a plain list anyone can read without a Keap login.

watchOut: Replace mode overwrites the tab, so set “Add or Replace Text In Tab” to add if you want history kept.
